events.title: Opposition protest against constitutional change
events.source_type: Actualite.cd; corroborating local report at Digital Congo
events.excerpt: Ce jeudi, la situation était tendue dans la commune de Masina (district de Tshangu), dans l’est de Kinshasa où des jeunes se réclamant de l’ECiDé
events.notes: Local reports say youths affiliated with ECiDé briefly blocked Boulevard Lumumba and burned tires/barricades protesting constitutional changes. Event is geographically Kinshasa, DRC.

events.location: Boulevard Triomphal near People's Palace/Parliament, Kinshasa
events.title: Opposition C64 sit-in against proposed constitutional amendment
events.source_type: Radio Okapi report republished by AllAfrica; CNDH-RDC follow-up and local reports also opened
events.excerpt: Les incidents survenus vendredi 12 juin 2026 aux abords du Palais du peuple à Kinshasa, lors du sit-in de l'opposition
events.notes: Local reporting and CNDH-RDC follow-up confirm opposition sit-in. Reported casualty details are disputed; they are not included.
